title: Far too small for a medium sized recliner.  Had to return.
text: Far too small for a medium sized recliner.  Had to return.. My fault, possibly, as I probably should have measured.  The strap didn't come close to stretching across the back of the recliner, even with the stretch-factor.  Nice material, good color and well made.  I'll keep looking.

product_metadata.title: WalterDrake Multi-Purpose Recliner Cushion – 100% Polyester Velour Recliner Pad Cover – Head & Neck Support, Lower Back Support or Lumbar Support Cushion
features: Recliner Neck Rest – You can position the rounded end of the multi-purpose cushion behind your neck, generating the support you need when lying in a recliner
Memory Foam Cushion – This support cushion design is made for maximum comfort, using a memory foam interior to mold to your body
Strapped in Place – The elastic strap that connects to the flat edge back of the recliner chair cushion will wrap around the chair, keeping the back cushion in place
Machine Washable Cover – Should the cover on the lumbar support cushion become soiled, you can clean it in a washing machine
Helps with Surgery Recovery – If you are lying flat in your recliner to help with recovery from surgery, this cushion will fit the chair perfectly, giving you the support you need
description: Designed specifically for the recliner, this unique Multipurpose recliner cushion's extralong elastic strap stretches around the recliner backpositioning and comforting you in multiple ways. Use this chair pad to cushion and bolster your head, neck or back; slide it down to the seat area for lower back support; it even offers lumbar support when recliner is positioned flat, comforting you when sleeping in the recliner due to surgery or back issues. The versatile memory foam recliner cushion also works as a foot rest on the bottom of the recliner to elevate legs or feet. Soft, 100 polyester velour recliner pad cover removes for easy machine washing. Dark Brown. 19 1/2" long x 8" wide x 4" high. Imported.
